Gunnar Henderson and his Baltimore Orioles will take on the Toronto Blue Jays at Oriole Park at Camden Yards, on Monday, Sept. 21 at 6:35 p.m. ET. Henderson has +520 odds to hit a home run as of Monday afternoon.
What It Means
Henderson is hitting for a .223 BA, .308 OBP and .397 SLG with a 22% strikeout rate and a 9.5% walk rate. His OPS is .705 and he has scored 86 runs. In 686 plate appearances, he has hit 23 home runs and driven in 58 runs. Henderson has recorded 10 steals on 15 attempts. He had a hitless showing in his last game (0 for 3) against the Brewers.
The Blue Jays will send Trey Yesavage (5-5) out for his 19th start of the season. He is 5-5 with a 3.65 ERA and 91 strikeouts in 93 2/3 innings pitched.
NOTE: Odds are subject to change. Please check FanDuel Sportsbook for the most up-to-date betting markets.
